title: OpenAI is enlisting an influencer army to make it look 'good for the world'
summary: This article reveals OpenAI's strategic use of influencer marketing and brand sponsorships across social media platforms like Instagram to reshape public perception of ChatGPT and position AI as beneficial to society. The piece examines how the company is building a network of content creators to normalize AI usage among mainstream audiences.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of building public trust and positive sentiment around AI technology amid growing concerns about its societal impact.
why_valuable: Provides insight into how major AI companies are navigating public relations and brand building in an era of increased scrutiny over artificial intelligence.
